questions.prompt: You c-bet top pair on K72 rainbow. The turn is a blank and you are called by one player. Best default?

choices.text: Bet again for value, smaller than a bluff on a scare card.
Give up because they called one street

questions.explanation: Top pair is still ahead of a float. One call is not a set every time.

questions.prompt: You c-bet air on K72. The turn is the third heart and you have no heart. Best default?

choices.text: Check. The scare card hits the caller’s draws more than your air.
Bet pot as a bluff every time
Bet small and call a raise

questions.explanation: Give up when the card helps the range that continued and you have no equity and no blocker.

questions.prompt: You checked back middle pair on the flop. The turn is a blank. A delayed bet…

choices.text: Can be a small value bet or a check again. It is not mandatory.
Is illegal after a flop check
Means you had the nuts on the flop

questions.explanation: Delay when the turn helps you or when a small bet gets worse to fold. Check again when you only have showdown.

questions.prompt: Out of position, you check-called the flop with a draw and the turn fills it. You should…

choices.text: Bet or raise for value. The draw became a made hand.
Only call if they bet the minimum

questions.explanation: When the draw arrives, stop playing it like a draw. Charge worse hands.
